title: Why Tariqats?
body:
Sharia gives the commands, the orders and the rules. Tariqat gives the adab to all these rules. Tariqat makes
people to love Islam. Tariqat makes people to be able to taste Islam. Tariqat take people to the meanings of
Islam.Tariqat take people to the wisdom of Sharia. Sharia gives advice, tariqat take people to the wisdom of
the advice. Sharia can show a picture of the person, but tariqat will take you to the person. People are so often
objecting and are asking what tariqats are good for. These are the reasons for tariqat.
Pakistan - 21.11.1991
